P.R. Venkat / Wall Street Journal :

 SK Hynix says its SSD subsidiary Solidigm has halted a review of a potential US IPO to fund a new US chip fab, citing “market conditions and share price trends”   —  SK Hynix's shares fell as much as 4.2% in early trade in Seoul  —  SK Hynix halted plans to list its memory-chip unit in the U.S. …
